title: Special Weather Statement by NWS - NewsBreak
text:
56 minutes ago Check NWS updates here
Effective: 2026-03-04 22:13:00 CST Expires: 2026-03-04 23:00:00 CST Urgency: Expected Severity: Moderate Certainty: Observed Instruction: If outdoors, consider seeking shelter inside a building. A Severe Thunderstorm Watch remains in effect until 1100 PM CST for southern Illinois. Target Area: Johnson; Pope; Massac At 1012 PM CST, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm near Karnak, or near Vienna, moving northeast at 35 mph.
HAZARD...Nickel size hail.
SOURCE...Radar indicated.
IMPACT...Minor hail damage to vegetation is possible.
Locations impacted include... Vienna, Dixon Springs, New Columbia, New Burnside, Belknap, Eddyville, and Simpson.
This includes Interstate 24 in Illinois between Mile Markers 12 and 25.
